title: Closed-fibre quotient of the tensor kernel vanishes
statement: Let the local rings, local maps, tensor product D, map F, flatness, surjectivity, and kernel equality be as in lem-weil-pbc-finite-coefficient-tensor-kernel-reduction. Writing K = ker F and L = m_A D, every x ∈ K maps to zero in the quotient D/(L K).

proof.text: Use flat tensor exactness to inject the kernel modulo m_A into the tensor product modulo m_A. Residue-field surjectivity reduces every tensor class to c tensor 1; the kernel equality puts a vanishing image in m₀C, and balancing puts c tensor 1 in m_A times the original kernel.
